svg.title: NotebookLM Clone – Single-Worker Edge Architecture / NotebookLM Klon – Single-Worker Edge-Architektur
svg.desc: Architecture overview: browser PWA with a Web Worker for parsing/OCR, a single Cloudflare Worker with Hono API, D1 SQLite database, R2 media storage, NotebookDO and JobDO, and multiple LLM providers. / Architekturübersicht: Browser PWA mit Web Worker für Parsing/OCR, Cloudflare Single-Worker mit Hono API, D1 SQLite Datenbank, R2 Medienspeicher, NotebookDO und JobDO sowie Multi-LLM-Provider.
